caption: The drawing depicts a black formal suit consisting of a jacket and knee-length breeches, both adorned with ornate, light-colored trim. The jacket has a high collar and features four horizontal rows of decorative trim with intricate loops across the chest, following the closure line down the front. The cuffs and lower edges of the jacket also display matching trim details, with a vertical trim pattern on the sides of the cuffs. The breeches are decorated with similar horizontal bands of trim down each leg. The background of the drawing is a plain tan color, and there is a simple outlined shape at the neck indicating the position of a head, but no facial features or other body parts are included. The composition is centered, showing only the garment without any additional objects or embellishments.
title: Boy's Suit
